readings.title: Prophecy Against the Shepherds
readings.subtitle: Woe to those who feed themselves and not the flock.
readings.text:
[Ezekiel 34:1] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to <dn>me</dn>, saying,
[2] “Son of man, prophesy against <dn>את</dn> the shepherds of Yisra’ěl, prophesy and say to them, <dq>‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to the shepherds, “Woe to the shepherds of Yisra’ěl who have been feeding themselves! Should not the shepherds feed the flock?</dq>
[3] <dq>“You eat <dn>את</dn> the fat and you put on the wool. You slaughter the fatlings – you do not feed the flock.</dq>
[4] <dq>“You have not strengthened <dn>את</dn> the weak, nor have you healed the sick, nor bound up the broken, nor brought back the straying, nor sought what was lost; but you have ruled them with might and harshness.</dq>
[5] <dq>“And they were scattered because there was no shepherd. And they became food for all the beasts of the field when they were scattered.</dq>
[6] <dq>“<dn>My</dn> sheep wandered through all the mountains, and on every high hill. And <dn>My</dn> sheep were scattered over all the face of the earth, and no one was seeking or searching for them.”</dq>
[7] Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>:
[8] <dq>“As <dn>I</dn> live,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“because <dn>My</dn> flock became a prey, and <dn>My</dn> flock became food for every beast of the field, from not having a shepherd, and <dn>My</dn> shepherds did not search for <dn>My</dn> flock, but the shepherds fed themselves and did not feed <dn>My</dn> flock,”</dq>
[9] therefore, O shepherds, hear the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>!
[10] Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> am against the shepherds, and shall require <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> flock at their hand, and shall make them cease feeding <dn>את</dn> the sheep, and the shepherds shall feed themselves no more. And <dn>I</dn> shall deliver <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> flock from their mouths, and they shall no longer be food for them.”</dq>

readings.title: The True Shepherd Gathers His Flock
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH Himself will seek, save, and feed His scattered sheep.
readings.text:
[11] For thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> shall search for <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> sheep and seek them out.</dq>
[12] <dq>“As a shepherd seeks out his flock on the day he is among his scattered sheep, so <dn>I</dn> shall seek out <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> sheep and deliver them from all the places where they were scattered in a day of cloud and thick darkness.</dq>
[13] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall bring them out from <dn>את</dn> the peoples and gather them from the lands, and shall bring them to their own land. And <dn>I</dn> shall feed them on the mountains of Yisra’ěl, in the valleys, and in all the dwellings of the land.</dq>
[14] <dq>“In good pasture <dn>I</dn> shall feed them, and their fold shall be on the high mountains of Yisra’ěl. They shall lie there in a good fold and feed in rich pasture on the mountains of Yisra’ěl.</dq>
[15] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall feed <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> flock and make them lie down,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[16] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall seek out <dn>את</dn> the lost and bring back <dn>את</dn> the strayed. And <dn>I</dn> shall bind up <dn>את</dn> the broken and strengthen <dn>את</dn> what was sick, but <dn>את</dn> the fat and <dn>את</dn> the strong <dn>I</dn> shall destroy. <dn>I</dn> shall feed them with right-ruling.”</dq>

readings.title: Judgment Between the Sheep
readings.subtitle: The fat sheep will be judged, and David will be their shepherd.
readings.text:
[17] And as for you, O <dn>My</dn> flock, thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> am judging between sheep and sheep, between rams and goats.</dq>
[18] <dq>“Is it not enough for you to have eaten up <dn>את</dn> the good pasture, and the rest of your pasture you trample with <dn>את</dn> your feet. Or that you should drink of <dn>את</dn> the clear waters, and the rest you muddy with <dn>את</dn> your feet?</dq>
[19] <dq>“And as for <dn>My</dn> flock, they eat <dn>את</dn> what you have trampled with your feet, and they drink <dn>את</dn> what you have muddied with your feet.”</dq>
[20] Therefore thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to them, <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> shall judge between fat and lean sheep.</dq>
[21] <dq>“Because you have pushed with flank and shoulder, and thrust at all the weak ones with your horns, and scattered them abroad,</dq>
[22] <dq>therefore <dn>I</dn> shall save <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> flock, and let them no longer be a prey. And <dn>I</dn> shall judge between sheep and sheep.</dq>
[23] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall raise up over them one shepherd, <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> servant Daviḏ, and he shall feed them. <dn>He</dn> shall feed them and be their shepherd.</dq>
[24] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, shall be their <dn>Elohim</dn>, and <dn>My</dn> servant Daviḏ a prince in their midst. <dn>I</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, have spoken.</dq>

readings.title: The Covenant of Peace
readings.subtitle: Blessings of safety, fruitfulness, and deliverance.
readings.text:
[25] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall make a covenant of peace with <dn>את</dn> them, and make evil beasts cease from the land. And they shall dwell safely in the wilderness and sleep in the forest.</dq>
[26] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall make them and <dn>את</dn> the places all around <dn>My</dn> hill a blessing, and shall cause showers to come down in their season – showers of blessing they are.</dq>
[27] <dq>“And the trees of the field shall yield their fruit and the earth yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land. And they shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, when <dn>I</dn> have broken <dn>את</dn> the bars of their yoke. And <dn>I</dn> shall deliver them from the hand of those who enslaved them,</dq>
[28] <dq>and they shall no longer be a prey for the nations, and the beast of the earth shall not devour them. And they shall dwell safely, with no one to make them afraid.</dq>
[29] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall raise up for them a planting place of name, and they shall no longer be consumed by hunger in the land, nor bear the shame of the nations any more.</dq>
[30] <dq>“And they shall know that <dn>I</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> their <dn>Elohim</dn>, am with them, and that they, the house of Yisra’ěl, are <dn>My</dn> people,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.’ ”
[31] <dq>“And you, <dn>My</dn> flock, the flock of <dn>My</dn> pasture, are men, and <dn>I</dn> am your <dn>Elohim</dn>,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.’ ”

readings.title: Prophecy Against Mount Seir
readings.subtitle: Edom will become an everlasting ruin for its hatred of Israel.
readings.text:
[Ezekiel 35:1] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to <dn>me</dn>, saying,
[2] “Son of man, set <dn>את</dn> your face against Mount Sě‛ir and prophesy against it,
[3] and you shall say to it, <dq>‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “See, O Mount Sě‛ir, <dn>I</dn> am against you, and shall stretch out <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> hand against you, and shall make you a ruin and a waste.</dq>
[4] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> destroy <dn>את</dn> your cities, and let you be a ruin. And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[5] <dq>“Because you have had a continuous enmity, and handed <dn>את</dn> the children of Yisra’ěl over to the power of the sword at the time of their calamity, at the time of the crookedness of the end.</dq>
[6] <dq>“Therefore, as <dn>I</dn> live,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall appoint you for blood, and let blood pursue you. Since you did not hate blood, therefore blood shall pursue you.</dq>
[7] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall make <dn>את</dn> Mount Sě‛ir a ruin and a waste, and cut off from it <dn>את</dn> the one who leaves and <dn>את</dn> the one who returns,</dq>
[8] <dq>and shall fill <dn>את</dn> its mountains with the slain, those slain by the sword falling on your hills and in your valleys and in all your ravines.</dq>
[9] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall make you an everlasting ruin, and your cities uninhabited. And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[10] <dq>“Because you have said, ‘These two nations and these two lands are mine, and we shall possess them,’ although <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> was there,</dq>
[11] <dq>therefore, as <dn>I</dn> live,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall do according to your displeasure and according to your envy which you showed in your hatred against them. And <dn>I</dn> shall make <dn>Myself</dn> known among them when <dn>I</dn> judge you.</dq>
[12] <dq>“And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. <dn>I</dn> have heard <dn>את</dn> all your scorns which you have spoken against the mountains of Yisra’ěl, saying, ‘They are laid waste, they were given to us for food.’</dq>
[13] <dq>“And with your mouth you have boasted against <dn>Me</dn> and increased <dn>את</dn> your words against <dn>Me</dn> – <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> have heard.”</dq>
[14] Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“As all the earth is rejoicing <dn>I</dn> shall make you a ruin.</dq>
[15] <dq>“As you rejoiced because the inheritance of the house of Yisra’ěl was laid waste, so <dn>I</dn> do to you: be a ruin, O Mount Sě‛ir, as well as <dn>את</dn> all of Eḏom, all of it! And they shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” ’</dq>

readings.title: Prophecy to the Mountains of Israel
readings.subtitle: The land will be restored from its shame and desolation.
readings.text:
[Ezekiel 36:1] “And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Yisra’ěl, and you shall say, ‘O mountains of Yisra’ěl, hear <dn>את</dn> the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>!
[2] Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“Because the enemy has said of you, ‘Aha! The heights of old have become our possession,’ ” ’</dq>
[3] therefore prophesy, and you shall say, <dq>‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “Because they laid you waste and swallowed you up on every side, so that you became the possession of the rest of the nations, and you are taken up by the lips of talkers and slandered by the people,”</dq>
[4] therefore, O mountains of Yisra’ěl, hear <dn>את</dn> the word of the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, and to the deserted ruins, and to the cities that have been forsaken, which became a prey and a mocking to the rest of the nations all around;
[5] therefore thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“Have <dn>I</dn> not spoken in <dn>My</dn> burning jealousy against the rest of the nations and against all Eḏom, who gave <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> land to themselves as a possession, with all joy of heart, with scorn in their being, to drive it out for a prey?” ’</dq>
[6] <dq>“Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Yisra’ěl, and you shall say to mountains, and to hills, to rivers, and to valleys, ‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “See, <dn>I</dn> have spoken in <dn>My</dn> jealousy and <dn>My</dn> wrath, because you have borne the shame of the nations.”</dq>
[7] Therefore thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“<dn>I</dn> have lifted <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> hand in an oath that the nations that are around you shall bear their own shame.</dq>
[8] <dq>“But you, O mountains of Yisra’ěl, put forth <dn>את</dn> your branches and bear <dn>את</dn> your fruit to <dn>My</dn> people Yisra’ěl, for they are about to come!</dq>
[9] <dq>“For look, <dn>I</dn> am for you, and <dn>I</dn> shall turn to you, and you shall be tilled and sown.</dq>
[10] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall increase men upon you, <dn>את</dn> all the house of Yisra’ěl, all of it. And the cities shall be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.</dq>
[11] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall increase upon you <dn>את</dn> man and beast, and they shall increase and bear young. And <dn>I</dn> shall make you inhabited as of old, and do better for you than at your beginnings. And you shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>
[12] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall let men, <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> people Yisra’ěl, walk upon you, and let them possess you, and you shall be their inheritance, and no longer let you add to their bereavement.”</dq>
[13] Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“Because they say to you, ‘You devour <dn>את</dn> men and have bereaved <dn>את</dn> your nation,’</dq>
[14] <dq>therefore you shall no longer devour <dn>את</dn> men, and no longer bereave <dn>את</dn> your nation,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.
[15] <dq>“And no longer shall <dn>I</dn> let you hear <dn>את</dn> the insults of the nations. And <dn>את</dn> the reproach of the peoples you shall bear no more, and no longer cause <dn>את</dn> your nations to stumble,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.’ ”

readings.title: For My Name's Sake
readings.subtitle: Israel profaned the Name, but YeHoVaH will act to set it apart.
readings.text:
[16] And the word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> came to <dn>me</dn>, saying,
[17] <dq>“Son of man, when the house of Yisra’ěl dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own ways and deeds. To <dn>Me</dn> their way was like the uncleanness of a woman in her monthly period.</dq>
[18] <dq>“So <dn>I</dn> poured out <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> wrath on them for the blood they had shed on the land, and for their idols they defiled it.</dq>
[19] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed throughout the lands. <dn>I</dn> have judged them according to their ways and their deeds.</dq>
[20] <dq>“And when they came to the nations, wherever they went, they profaned <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> set-apart Name for it was said of them, ‘These are the people of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and yet they have gone out of <dn>His</dn> land.’</dq>
[21] <dq>“But <dn>I</dn> had compassion on <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> set-apart Name, which the house of Yisra’ěl had profaned among the nations wherever they went.</dq>
[22] “Therefore say to the house of Yisra’ěl, <dq>‘Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “<dn>I</dn> do not do this for your sake, O house of Yisra’ěl, but for <dn>My</dn> set-apart Name’s sake, which you have profaned among the nations wherever you went.</dq>
[23] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall set apart <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> great Name, which has been profaned among the nations, which you have profaned in their midst. And the nations shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“when <dn>I</dn> am set-apart in you before their eyes.</dq>

readings.title: A New Heart and a New Spirit
readings.subtitle: The promise of cleansing, spiritual renewal, and restoration.
readings.text:
[24] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall take you from among the nations, and <dn>I</dn> shall gather you out of all lands, and <dn>I</dn> shall bring you into your own land.</dq>
[25] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall sprinkle clean water on you, and you shall be clean – from all your filthiness and from all your idols <dn>I</dn> cleanse you.</dq>
[26] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you. And <dn>I</dn> shall take <dn>את</dn> the heart of stone out of your flesh, and <dn>I</dn> shall give you a heart of flesh,</dq>
[27] <dq>and put <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Spirit within you. And <dn>I</dn> shall cause you to walk in <dn>My</dn> laws and guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> right-rulings and shall do them.</dq>
[28] <dq>“And you shall dwell in the land that <dn>I</dn> gave to your fathers. And you shall be <dn>My</dn> people, and <dn>I</dn> shall be your <dn>Elohim</dn>.</dq>
[29] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall save you from all your uncleannesses. And <dn>I</dn> shall call for the grain and increase it, and <dn>I</dn> shall bring no scarcity of food upon you.</dq>
[30] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall increase <dn>את</dn> the fruit of your trees and <dn>את</dn> the increase of your fields, so that you need never again bear the reproach of scarcity of food among the nations.</dq>
[31] <dq>“And you shall remember <dn>את</dn> your evil ways and <dn>את</dn> your deeds that were not good. And you shall loathe yourselves in your own eyes, for your crookednesses and your abominations.</dq>
[32] <dq>“Not for your sake am <dn>I</dn> acting,”</dq> declares the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“let it be known to you. Be ashamed and blush for your ways, O house of Yisra’ěl!”</dq>

readings.title: The Land Like the Garden of Eden
readings.subtitle: The desolate land will be rebuilt and filled with people.
readings.text:
[33] Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“On the day that <dn>I</dn> cleanse you from all your crookednesses, <dn>I</dn> shall cause the cities to be inhabited, and the ruined places shall be rebuilt,</dq>
[34] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> the land that was laid waste tilled instead of being a ruin before the eyes of all who pass by.</dq>
[35] <dq>“And they shall say, ‘This land that was laid waste has become like the garden of Ěḏen. And the wasted, the deserted, and the destroyed cities are now walled and inhabited.’</dq>
[36] <dq>“Then the nations which are left all around you shall know that <dn>I</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, have rebuilt <dn>את</dn> the destroyed places and planted <dn>את</dn> what was laid waste. <dn>I</dn>, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, have spoken it, and <dn>I</dn> shall do it.”</dq>
[37] Thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“Once again <dn>I</dn> shall let the house of Yisra’ěl inquire of <dn>Me</dn> to do for them: <dn>I</dn> shall increase their men like a flock.</dq>
[38] <dq>“As a set-apart flock, as the flock at Yerushalayim at her appointed times, so shall the wasted cities be filled with flocks of men. And they shall know that <dn>I</dn> am <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.” ’ ”</dq>
